name: site-qa
description: Local verification loop: jekyll build -> DevTools video/scroll metrics (qa.py) -> Lighthouse CI assertions -> Playwright visual regression. `npm run qa` before every push.

scripts.build: cd ../.. && bundle exec jekyll build --quiet --config _config.yml,tools/qa/jekyll.local.yml 2>&1 | grep -v '^Terser' ; test -f _site/index.html
scripts.qa: npm run build && python3 qa.py --no-build --out ../../_qa --throttle 20 && npm run qa:lh && npm run qa:visual
scripts.qa:live: python3 qa.py --no-build --out ../../_qa --url https://yuchenhou.me && SITE_URL=https://yuchenhou.me playwright test --grep-invert 'approved look'
